name: SilenceCut — One-Click Silence Remover for Talking-Head Video (Local)
description:
My raw talking-head takes are 20–40% dead air — how do I cut all the silence automatically instead of scrubbing timelines by hand? Cutting it by hand is scrubbing timelines; the free tool that does it automatically speaks in thresholds, margins and command lines.
SilenceCut is that engine with a face: pick the video, pick a cutting style, click once.
PRESETS, IN PLAIN LANGUAGE
• Talking head — standard (everyday YouTube & course videos)
• Short-form — tight (Shorts / Reels / TikTok pacing)
• Lecture / interview — gentle (keeps natural pauses, cuts only the dead air)
PLUS WHAT THE RAW ENGINE DOESN'T GIVE YOU
• Optional loudness normalization to −16 LUFS in the same pass
• A re-check report measured on the OUTPUT file: duration before → after, seconds of dead air removed, silence remaining, loudness before → after
THE HONEST PART
This removes silences and gaps. It does not remove filler words (um, uh) — those are speech, not silence, and any tool claiming a threshold slider can hear words is overselling. If your problem is dead air between sentences, this is the fix.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Seeded 9-second test take (3s speech-level tone, 3s silence, 3s tone): standard preset cut it to 6.5s — 2.5s of dead air gone, silence 3.0s → 0.4s, loudness normalized −11.8 → −15.9 LUFS. All measured on the output.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no uploads of unreleased videos, no per-minute fees, no subscription. Built on the open-source auto-editor engine (Unlicense) with pinned, bundled builds — nothing else to install.
Windows 10/11. Works on mp4 / mov / mkv and anything ffmpeg reads.
